_comment: Terms the translator must handle a specific way.
keep_as_is: leave untouched (names, fandom loanwords, show titles).
mappings: force a specific Spanish rendering.
notes: free-text guidance appended to the system prompt.
notes: This is a K-pop variety show. Keep the energy high and the register casual. Members roast each other constantly — preserve the teasing. Baskin-Robbins flavor names (Rainbow Sherbet, Shooting Star, Apple Mint, Mom Is an Alien, etc.) are product names — keep them in English like the store name itself, never translate. 'Baemon' is the fan nickname for BABYMONSTER. 'CHOOM' is a comeback/title-track name — keep untranslated like a song title. 'PICK ME' is the Produce 101 catchphrase reference — keep in English. 'RURU' is RUKA's nickname — recurs across multiple videos, keep untranslated, don't mistake it for a typo. 'K-Pop ON!' is Spotify's recurring video-podcast franchise name (appears at the end of Spotify-produced episodes) — keep untranslated like a show title. Song lyric captions quoted on screen (bracketed or not) are left in English per standing rule — only the surrounding commentary/captions get translated. Ad hoc portmanteau nicknames a single episode invents on the spot for a member pairing (e.g. combining two members' names as a joke) are one-off wordplay, not standing terms — translate/localize them fresh each time rather than treating them as fixed glossary entries, since these episodes are independent one-offs, not a connected season.
